features.name: Market data command
features.description: The td-data command line tool for the local candle store.
features.inputs: A subcommand and its flags; TD_DATA_DIR picks the store.
features.outputs: The subcommand's output; help text without a subcommand.

features.name: List a venue's instruments
features.description: Lists the instruments a venue has open for trading, with their trading rules and fees.
features.outputs: One tab-separated row per instrument on stdout; left-out symbols and a count on stderr.

features.name: Download history
features.description: Downloads 1-minute candles, and funding rates for a perpetual, into the store.
features.inputs: --venue, --kind, --symbol, --from and --to as YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); OANDA_API_TOKEN for FX.
features.outputs: Month files in the store and a report of what was written and what is missing.

features.name: Show stored coverage
features.description: Shows which months and minutes the store holds for one instrument.
features.outputs: The stored months and up to 20 runs of missing minutes.

features.name: List stored data
features.description: Lists every instrument the store holds, with the size of each month file and funding file.
features.outputs: One block per instrument with its months and sizes, and any unrecognised files.

features.name: Delete stored data
features.description: Deletes an instrument's candles for a range of months, or the whole instrument.
features.outputs: What was removed; refused while the instrument is being downloaded.

features.name: Live session command
features.description: The td-live command line tool that runs a strategy on a venue's demo-trading account.
features.inputs: A subcommand and its flags; demo keys from the environment.
features.outputs: The subcommand's output; help text without a subcommand.

features.name: Start a live session
features.description: Creates a live demo session with its stop rules and runs it until it halts or Ctrl-C.
features.outputs: A session folder under <data dir>/live/<id>/ and one line per event.

features.name: Resume a live session
features.description: Runs a saved live session again with the stop rules it was created with.
features.outputs: The session's log replayed and continued; one line per event.

features.name: Show a live session's status
features.description: Prints a session's saved status, stop state and the verdict it was started from, without touching the venue.
features.outputs: The status lines on stdout.

features.name: Flatten a live session
features.description: Cancels a session's resting orders, closes its position reduce-only and ends it.
features.outputs: The orders cancelled and the close sent; the session ends.

features.name: Compare a live session with a backtest
features.description: Sets a session's fills beside a backtest over its own saved bars, without touching the venue.
features.outputs: The fills side by side and where they differ.

features.name: Engine sidecar
features.description: The localhost API the desktop app starts; it prints a port and token and serves the routes below.
features.inputs: --port; TD_TOKEN, TD_DATA_DIR and TD_DATA_CUTOFF from the environment.
features.outputs: One handshake line on stdout with the port and token; logs on stderr.

features.name: Generate the GUI's API types
features.description: Writes the TypeScript API types the GUI builds against from the server's Rust types.
features.outputs: gui/shared/src/api-types.ts.

features.name: Benchmark the engine
features.description: Times the engine's real work on synthetic data and prints a results checksum.
features.outputs: WORKLOAD, PHASES and BENCH lines on stdout.

features.name: Demo order smoke test
features.description: Sends real orders to the venue's demo account to check the order route end to end: a market buy, a reduce-only stop read back, amended and cancelled, a repeated client id and a reduce-only close.
features.inputs: --confirm-send-orders and --symbol (a trading USDT perpetual), through cargo run -p td-orders --example demo-smoke; BYBIT_DEMO_API_KEY and BYBIT_DEMO_API_SECRET.
features.outputs: One line per step on stdout, then PASS, or FAIL with what may be left open on the account.

features.name: Cross-check engine side
features.description: This engine's side of the NautilusTrader cross-check: fetches and exports a case's data, runs its backtest, and measures an equity curve.
features.reason: Started only by harness/crosscheck/run.py, which builds it with cargo.
features.inputs: fetch <case.json> <harness dir>, run <case.json> <harness dir> <real|gapless> <out.json>, or metrics <curve.json> <out.json>.
features.outputs: The case's exported bars, funding and meta.json; the run's fills, orders, trades, equity and metrics as JSON; or a metrics report as JSON.

features.name: Engine health
features.description: Says whether the engine is up, and the data cutoff in force.
features.outputs: JSON status.

features.name: Instrument list
features.description: Lists a venue's instruments of one kind with their trading rules.
features.outputs: JSON instruments and the symbols left out.

features.name: Start a download
features.description: Starts a background job that downloads an instrument's history into the store.
features.outputs: A job id to follow on /jobs and /ws.

features.name: Stored coverage
features.description: Reports which months and minutes the store holds for an instrument.
features.outputs: JSON months and missing spans.

features.name: Stored data list
features.description: Lists every stored instrument with its months and sizes.
features.outputs: JSON instruments, months and byte sizes.

features.name: Delete one instrument's data
features.description: Deletes an instrument's stored candles and funding.
features.inputs: JSON instrument and optional month range.
features.outputs: JSON report of what was removed.

features.name: Delete all market data
features.description: Deletes every stored candle and funding file, keeping saved runs and sessions.
features.outputs: JSON report of what was removed.

features.name: Chart candles
features.description: Returns stored and venue candles for the Trading chart.
features.inputs: instrument, timeframe, from and to query parameters.
features.outputs: JSON candles.

features.name: Strategy list
features.description: Lists the registered strategies with their parameters, test plans and code hashes.
features.outputs: JSON strategies.

features.name: Job list
features.description: Lists the background jobs and their status.
features.outputs: JSON jobs.

features.name: One job
features.description: Shows one background job's status and progress.
features.outputs: JSON job.

features.name: Cancel a job
features.description: Asks a running job to stop at its next checkpoint.
features.outputs: JSON job after the request.

features.name: Job result
features.description: Returns a finished run job's result.
features.outputs: JSON result of the run.

features.name: Saved runs
features.description: Lists the saved runs.
features.outputs: JSON run summaries.

features.name: Run a backtest
features.description: Starts a backtest of a strategy over stored data.
features.outputs: A job id; the result is saved as a run.

features.name: Run a sweep
features.description: Starts a parameter sweep of a strategy.
features.inputs: JSON base configuration and parameter axes.
features.outputs: A job id; the result is saved as a run.

features.name: Run an out-of-sample test
features.description: Starts an in-sample sweep followed by an out-of-sample run of the best set.
features.outputs: A job id; the result is saved as a run.

features.name: Run a walk-forward test
features.description: Starts a walk-forward test over rolling windows.
features.outputs: A job id; the result is saved as a run.

features.name: Run a test battery
features.description: Runs a strategy's test plan and saves its verdict.
features.inputs: JSON strategy, instrument and optional references, series and other traded instruments.
features.outputs: A job id; a saved verdict.

features.name: Saved verdicts
features.description: Lists the saved battery verdicts with whether each is stale.
features.outputs: JSON verdict rows.

features.name: One saved run
features.description: Returns a saved run with whether its strategy code and data still match.
features.outputs: JSON run.

features.name: Paper session list
features.description: Lists the paper sessions.
features.outputs: JSON session summaries.

features.name: Start a paper session
features.description: Starts a paper session of a strategy, or of manual orders, on a live feed.
features.inputs: JSON strategy, parameters, instrument, timeframe and optional references.
features.outputs: JSON session id and state.

features.name: One paper session
features.description: Returns a paper session's state, orders, fills and equity.
features.outputs: JSON session state.

features.name: Stop a paper session
features.description: Stops a running paper session.
features.outputs: JSON session state.

features.name: Resume a paper session
features.description: Resumes a stopped paper session from its saved log.
features.outputs: JSON session state.

features.name: Compare a paper session with a backtest
features.description: Sets a paper session's fills beside a backtest over its own logged bars.
features.outputs: JSON comparison.

features.name: Place a manual paper order
features.description: Sends a manual order in a paper session.
features.inputs: The session id and a JSON order.
features.outputs: JSON order id, or the reason it was refused.

features.name: Cancel a manual paper order
features.description: Cancels an open manual order in a paper session.
features.inputs: The session id and order id.
features.outputs: JSON outcome.

features.name: Live updates
features.description: A WebSocket that streams job progress, live candles and paper session events.
features.inputs: The launch token and topic subscriptions.
features.outputs: JSON messages per topic.

features.name: Strategy Lab
features.description: The app section that lists strategies, runs a backtest and shows the result and verdict.
features.inputs: A strategy, instrument and range picked in the app.
features.outputs: The run's progress, metrics, equity chart and verdict.

features.name: Stored data view
features.description: The Lab view that lists stored data and deletes an instrument after asking.
features.outputs: The stored instruments with their sizes, updated after a delete.

features.name: Trading
features.description: The app section with the live chart, instrument search, paper sessions and manual orders.
features.inputs: An instrument, timeframe, strategy or manual orders picked in the app.
features.outputs: The live chart, the session panel, orders and fills.

features.name: Build the engine for the app
features.description: Builds the release td-server binary the app starts as its engine.
features.outputs: target/release/td-server.

features.name: Run the app in development
features.description: Builds the engine, then starts the app with live reload.
features.inputs: None; the data folder is the app default.
features.outputs: The app window and the engine it starts.

features.name: Run the app with secrets
features.description: Starts the app in development with the vault's secrets in its environment.
features.inputs: The secrets the hush vault holds for this project.
features.outputs: The app window and the engine it starts.

features.name: Build the app
features.description: Builds the app's main, preload and renderer bundles.
features.outputs: gui/app/out.

features.name: Build the installer
features.description: Builds the engine and the app, then the Windows installer.
features.outputs: An NSIS installer under gui/app/dist.

features.name: Check the installer
features.description: Installs the built installer into a temporary folder, launches it once on a fresh profile and uninstalls it.
features.outputs: INSTALL-CHECK PASS or INSTALL-CHECK FAIL with the reason.

features.name: Typecheck the GUI
features.description: Typechecks every GUI package.
features.outputs: Type errors, if any; exit 1 on an error.

features.name: Run the GUI unit tests
features.description: Runs the GUI's unit tests.
features.outputs: Test results; exit 1 on a failure.

features.name: Serve the renderer on the bridge stub
features.description: Serves the last renderer build on localhost with the bridge stub as window.td, so any state opens in a browser tab.
features.inputs: --port (default 4319); the page's query string picks the stub's configuration.
features.outputs: The URL it serves on.

features.name: Check the app quits
features.description: Launches the built app with the real engine, opens a section, closes the window and checks every process exits within 5 s.
features.inputs: The section to open: lab (default) or trading.
features.outputs: quit-check: PASS with the time to exit, or FAIL with the processes still running.

features.name: Write the Lab's mock fixtures
features.description: Writes the Lab's mock fixtures and the data of the engine stub pnpm serve uses, from a seeded random walk so every run writes the same files.
features.outputs: gui/app/mock/lab.json and gui/app/mock/engine.json.

features.name: Write Trading's mock fixtures
features.description: Writes Trading's mock fixtures: instruments for both venues and seeded 1h and 1m candle history for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT.
features.outputs: gui/app/mock/trading.json.

features.name: Cross-check against NautilusTrader
features.description: Runs the cross-check cases on this engine and on NautilusTrader and compares their fills and equity.
features.inputs: --case to pick cases (all by default); --fetch downloads and exports the data again.
features.outputs: reports/<case>.md per case and a count of the cases that pass; exit 1 if one fails.
